newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon raises price of gasoline, fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon raises price of gasoline, fuel oil.

text.p: Lebanon's industry and oil ministry slightly increased the price of gasoline and fuel oil on Tuesday after rises on international markets.
Oil Minister Chahe Barsoumian told Reuters he ordered increases of 10 Lebanese pounds (0.6 cent) per litre of gasoline and 25 pounds (1.6 cents) for fuel oil.
Super unleaded was increased to 590 pounds, regular to 570 pounds and fuel oil to 325 pounds.
Barsoumian said the decision headed off a looming shortage caused by the refusal of importers to supply petrol stations at the old prices, on the grounds that they were incurring losses.
"The companies called me today to say they will adhere to the new prices," Barsoumian said.

Bahij abu Hamzah, head of the association of oil importing companies, was quoted by newspapers as saying after a meeting with Barsoumian on Monday that the firms rejected the price rises and demanded bigger ones to offset losses caused by the increase in international fuel prices.
